pages.text: Quartz Enriched Iron is a fundamental material used in crafting many Refined Storage components. It is created by combining iron with quartz in a specific ratio.
Features:$(li)Basic crafting material$(li)Used in many device recipes$(li)Can be crafted into blocks$(li)Essential for early-game progression
To craft Quartz Enriched Iron:$(li)Combine iron ingots with quartz$(li)Use a 1:1 ratio$(li)Can be crafted in a regular crafting table$(li)Can be automated with autocrafting
